_comment: Rubric del pase de auto-crítica (paso 4): un segundo llamado al LLM puntúa el prompt final y, si algún criterio queda por debajo del umbral, lo reescribe. La lógica vive en api/prompt_architect.py.

criterios.descripcion: The subject is nameable and material (specific objects, wear, era, place), not a category label.
The frame reads: clear focal hierarchy, depth, and a clean, explicitly reserved clear zone for the text.

The piece reads as a designed poster, not a photo with a caption: the subject is anchored in the central band, lit so it separates from the type, and the photograph is full bleed to all four edges — the reserved clear zones are quiet regions of the photograph itself (shadow falloff, defocus, bare surface), never panels of flat colour, mattes or margins.
Palette and visual tone match the brand data supplied (typography is written by the app — do not score or rewrite it).
No empty adjectives, no stock-photo clichés, nothing that could describe any other post.

sistema: You are a demanding art director reviewing another director's image prompt. You score strictly against the rubric and rewrite only what falls short. You answer with JSON only.
